args.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. The site has a clean and simple design, which makes it easy to navigate. I appreciate that you included your contact information so visitors can easily reach you. If I may suggest, it would be great to see more content about yourself — for example, your background, interests, projects, or a portfolio section — to give visitors a richer picture of who you are. Adding a bit more detail and perhaps some visual elements could really make your site stand out. Keep up the good work!

Hi Eve! I just visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love that your blog reflects your passion for hiking — it gives the site a personal and authentic feel. It would be wonderful to see more posts about your hiking adventures, such as trail recommendations, photos from your hikes, or tips for fellow hikers. Adding more content like that could really engage your readers and build a community around your hobby. Great start, and I look forward to reading more!
